title: RWB-S6-E6011-APP: the settle-and-cancel slice has no plan row for its six consumed contracts, its inbox library, its rule kit, its settlement stamp, its GL prerequisite or its EP06 wave
source: Template and Rules v1 R3, R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R7.1 to R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6011-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, naming rules, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-011; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.15 and Screens; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.0 to T3.3, T4, T5.1 to T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-24, R-DS-25, R-DS-26, R-DS-27 and R-DS-29 to R-DS-31; Event and Messaging Design v4 event 25; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-DBS-11, FEAT-DBS-12 and FEAT-DBS-15; Business Requirements Program v4 rows REQ-S6-006 and REQ-S6-008
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E6011-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads rwb-source-data, rwb-case, rwb-partner, rwb-access and rwb-decision and answers the rwb-case case move, so six consumed rows have no plan row. (2) The step consumes event 25 ProceedsMatched, yet DP-09 is absent from the pattern set of this key, so the inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (3) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates the DEBTSALE route set of 41 rules over 29 states, so no Drools kit row RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and no C row RWB-P7-E1073-CON is held. (4) The money side of the lot has no column: TSD S6 T3.1 declares debt_sale_lot with DF-SAL-020 to DF-SAL-030 and debt_sale_account with DF-SAL-031 to DF-SAL-037, and none of them carries a settlement date, a matched amount or a proceeds reference, while LOV-LOT-STATUS has no SETTLED member. (5) The legacy dependency FEAT-DBS-12, derecognize and post to the general ledger, is a sibling story of this service whose story identifier the plan's H row does not carry. (6) The ACE reads of the legacy Data table, v_ace_payment and v_ace_score, cannot use the second branch of DP-05 because Architecture v5 slide 8 states that the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views are read only by rwb-source-data, so the own-views branch is closed and the read is one hop further away than the pattern allows for. (7) The buyer score of R-DS-26 has no owner column in any source: the scorecard is a partner fact of rwb-partner and the account score v_ace_score is not the buyer score, so the score is referenced and not computed. (8) The wave is EP06's 4 while rwb-debtsale is created in Arch v5 wave 3, a conflict the plan keeps by rule R5.6. (9) FSD S6 A2.15.4.4 declares no background event for the feature while the architecture and Event and Messaging Design v4 give the ProceedsMatched subscription, a conflict resolved by source precedence. (10) The legacy Data table names assignment and treatment, whose owners are not in the context pack slice for this WP. (11) The module extract holds no FSD or TSD S6 text, so the FSD S6 v3 and TSD S6 v2 files stand in as the module sources.
evidence: Split plan slice RWB-S6-E6011-APP H, C, I and X rows; TSD S6 T3.1 field list and T3.2 LOV-LOT-STATUS values BUILDING, OFFERED, AWARDED, TRANSFERRED, CLOSED; TSD S6 T-A.1 five operations with no settlement operation; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-24 to R-DS-27 and R-DS-29 to R-DS-31; Event and Messaging Design v4 row EV-25 with the payload proceedsId, caseId, amount and the Transactions rule; Architecture v5 slides 8 (30 views read only by rwb-source-data) and 19 IN and OUT; FSD S6 A2.15.4.4 'No background event' and A2.15.3.3 'None; runs unattended'; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-DBS-12 and FEAT-DBS-15, which gives FEAT-DBS-12 as the prerequisite
area: Dependencies, data model, event subscription, prerequisite
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows unchanged; build the app story on Day 1 against the six contract fakes and the event fake; record the six rows as C dependencies in fact and the inbox library, the rule kit, the settlement stamp and the FEAT-DBS-12 story as tracked items in the Dependency Map and the Build Sequence; keep wave 4 and the release date; reconcile the FSD and TSD module sources when the module extract is produced.

title: RWB-S6-E6011-CON: the consumed operation names, the ProceedsMatched envelope, the settlement element and the field-level types have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6011-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E6-011; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.15.2, A2.15.3.1, A2.15.4.4 and Screens; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-24 to R-DS-27; Event and Messaging Design v4 rows EV-23, EV-25 and the envelope rule
description: (1) The rwb-source-data payment data product publishes no operation name, so the consumed row carries a placeholder. (2) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, so the case move is declared as the child workflow's stage outcome and any REST case-move operation carries a placeholder. (3) The rwb-partner scorecard read and the rwb-access authorise call publish no operation name in the documents this WP may read. (4) The ProceedsMatched event is named in the event set with its payload, but no AsyncAPI catalogue publishes its CloudEvents envelope, so the envelope fields carry a placeholder. (5) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (6) TSD S6 T3.1 publishes the physical types of the two tables but no OpenAPI element, so the element names, required flags and field-level formats of the Settlement and Cancellation elements are fixed by this baseline and not copied from a source. (7) The settlement state has no lot status member, so the closed set pending, settled and cancelled is a contract decision that has to be signed off. (8) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares six consumed rows and one consumed event.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operations API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S6 T3.1 field list and T3.2 lists; Event and Messaging Design v4 row EV-25 (proceedsId, caseId, amount) and the CloudEvents rule row; Architecture v5 slide 19 IN (ProceedsMatched) and OUT (LotAwarded, AccountsTransferred); FSD S6 A2.15.4.4 'No background event' and A2.15.3.1 rows VR-S6-015-1, R-DS-25, R-DS-26, R-DS-27 and BR-S6-015
proposed: Tag the baseline with the placeholders in place; publish the OpenAPI fragment for the two elements and the AsyncAPI fragment for the consumed event; derive each fake from the published document and fail the build on drift; correct the rows in the Service Contract Catalog when the owners publish the operation names and the envelope.
